svg.title: Santiago de Compostela pilgrim's shell
svg.desc: The Camino scallop-shell symbol, its fan and radiating ribs traced with particles. Camino pilgrim shell adapted from St. James way shell.svg by Gambo7 / Spacejam2, Wikimedia Commons, public domain. Fan facing right, sign background omitted, and shell contour sampled into particles. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:St._James_way_shell.svg
